title: feat(record-page): a desktop comment panel beside the record, opened from a header icon; 动态 keeps system entries (#36075)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu7W7AujnHuifjn8Luh1TnAA)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXXdtDHm8mLZYX8Bsb

Part of #36075

Clause-②: yes (widening): `@object-ui/plugin-detail` adds exports (`CommentsPanel`, `CommentsButton`, `CommentThread`, `CommentItem`, `CommentComposer`, `CommentHoverActions`, `useRecordComments`, `buildCommentThreads`, `latestRepliers`, `RecordCommentsInPanelContext`) and their types (`CommentsPanelProps`, `CommentsButtonProps`, `RecordCommentThreadProps`, `CommentItemProps`, `CommentItemActions`, `CommentComposerProps`, `CommentHoverActionsProps`, `CommentThreadData`, `RecordCommentsData`), and an optional `reservedWidth` on `useRecordPageTier`. `RichTextCommentInput` (exported) now takes the `Esc` that closes its @ list (`preventDefault` and `stopPropagation`), so nothing round it acts on that key. `RecordActivityTimeline` draws no chip group when it is handed no chips. `@object-ui/components` adds an optional `comments` slot to `RecordTopBar` and `NavigationOverlay`, and the drawer leaves an `Esc` pressed inside a `[data-owns-escape]` region to that region. `@object-ui/i18n` adds five keys to every pack: `detail.closeComments`, `detail.collapseReplies`, `detail.commentActions`, `detail.commentsEmptyHint`, `detail.resolveThread`. Nothing existing is removed or re-typed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 电脑端的记录页和记录抽屉，头部（编辑按钮左边）多了一个评论图标，旁边是这条记录的评论数（顶层评论条数；#36071 合并后改成未解决的线程数）。点一下打开评论栏，再点一下关上；开着还是关着，浏览器会记住，记录页和抽屉各记各的。
- 评论栏宽 380：顶上「评论」和 ✕，中间是评论线程（最早的在上），评论框固定在最下面。一条评论有回复时显示「N 条回复」和最近回复人的头像，点开在原地展开，下面有回复框；在任意一条上点「回复」会展开这个线程、光标直接进回复框。
- 鼠标移到一条评论上，右上角出现一排操作：回复、表情、更多（自己的评论才有编辑、删除）。「已解决」按钮已经做好，等 #36071 合并后再接上，现在不显示。
- 窗口 1280 及以上，评论栏放在记录右边，记录内容让出 380；窗口小于 1280，评论栏盖在记录右侧。抽屉默认宽 720，评论栏盖住整个抽屉内容（✕ 或 Esc 回到记录，焦点回到评论图标；从列表打开的抽屉也一样，抽屉本身不关）；抽屉宽到 760 及以上才左右并排。
- 「动态」页签只剩系统条目（活动、字段变更），没有评论框，也没有「全部 / 活动 / 讨论」这三个筛选（卡上点名去掉的三个）。「变更」筛选照旧保留：记录开着字段历史时才有，点一下只看字段变更，再点一下回到全部。动态的数字也不再算评论。
- 只在平台默认记录页和只填插槽的页面上出现（方案 C，13:24Z）。完全手写的记录页不动：showcase 的 project-detail、sys-queue、sys-audit-log 三个页面照旧在页脚放讨论区；对象关了评论（`enable.feeds: false`）就没有图标。手机端这次不改，评论还在动态页签里，等 #36076。

## What changes

**The comment components** (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, new `src/comments/`)

- `useRecordComments()` reads the record's discussion off the host's `DiscussionContext` (the rows and the writes every feed block already gets) and returns the threads, the icon's count (`null` while unknown: loading, refused or failed), the loading, refused and failed states, and each write exactly where the host hands it. Nothing reads or writes any other way, so the phone's comment page (#36076) can reuse every piece.
- `buildCommentThreads(items)`: the `comment` rows only, threads oldest first, replies oldest first; a reply to a reply joins its thread; a reply whose parent is not held (deleted) stays as a thread of its own, so a delete never hides another member's reply.
- `CommentItem` (avatar, name, time, edited mark, text, reactions with the viewer's own marked; an inline editor where Esc cancels and Ctrl/⌘+Enter saves, the draft kept when the save is refused), `CommentThread` (`expand` for the panel, `summary` for the phone's list; actions handed out per comment through `renderActions`), `CommentComposer` (keeps the draft when the write is refused; `focusSignal` puts the caret in it), `CommentHoverActions` (the desktop's one action row), `CommentsPanel`, `CommentsButton`. Every face is #36070's shared `CommentAuthorAvatar`.
- `RecordCommentsInPanelContext`: while the host sets it, the default page's `record:activity` stream (the 动态 tab and the 概览 rail's 最近动态 card) drops comment rows, its 全部 / 活动 / 讨论 chips and its composer (the 变更 chip stays, on #30074's rule, and pressed again goes back to every entry), ignores a refused or failed comments read, and the tab row's count probe (`RecordTimelineCountProbe`) counts the same rows. An authored `record:activity` is untouched.
- **Esc** (L1-c rework at `09b716c8`): an `Esc` in the panel closes it and puts the focus back on the comments icon. The `@` list's `Esc` closes the list only (`RichTextCommentInput` now takes the key), so the draft is kept. The panel closes on an `Esc` whose target is in its own DOM; its portaled menus close themselves. `defaultPrevented` no longer decides, because the drawer marks the key to hold itself open. The section carries `data-owns-escape`.
- `useRecordPageTier(el, { reservedWidth })`: the tier is measured on the width left after the panel takes its 380.

**The record page and the drawer** (`@object-ui/app-shell`)

- One predicate, `commentsPanelOffered`, in `RecordDetailView`: an object definition with `enable.feeds !== false`, a page that takes the default columns (no assigned page, not a blocked named page: option C), not a phone, and a record id. It is the only place the rule lives.
- While the panel is offered, the discussion rides the record's open request (`streamDiscussion`), so the icon's count is known without opening the 动态 tab; activity stays lazy as before (`activityFeedWanted` is the old `feedWanted`).
- `recordCommentsPanel.tsx`: the widths and thresholds (`COMMENTS_PANEL_WIDTH` 380, `COMMENTS_PANEL_BESIDE_MIN_WINDOW` 1280, `COMMENTS_PANEL_DRAWER_SPLIT_MIN_WIDTH` 760), `commentsPanelPlacement` (`beside` / `over` / `cover`), the open state kept in `localStorage` (`os:record-comments-panel:page` and `:drawer`, every access guarded), and `RecordCommentsAside`.
- The icon sits in `RecordTopBar`'s new `comments` slot, ahead of the button group, on the page; the drawer portals it into the same slot through `RecordPaneBarApi.commentsSlot` (`RecordPaneBarComments`); a pane without the bar draws it in the page header's trailing controls.

**Drawer width chosen**: the default drawer is `md` (720), under the 760 split threshold, so the panel covers the drawer's body there; a drawer at 760 or wider splits, leaving the record at least as wide as the panel.

**Strings**: `detail.closeComments`, `collapseReplies`, `commentActions`, `commentsEmptyHint`, `resolveThread` in all eleven packs and the provider-less defaults; everything else reuses existing keys.

**Docs**: the plugin-detail README and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` describe the panel.

## Why

Card #36075 (phase 1 of epic #36062): comments were buried in the 动态 tab beside system entries, so a reader had to switch tabs to see or join a discussion. The card asks for a standalone comment panel on the desktop record page and drawer, reached from a header icon, and an Activity tab of system entries only.

## Side effects reviewers should know

- **Hand-written pages keep their old discussion** (option C, seat 13:24Z): showcase `project-detail`, `sys-queue` and `sys-audit-log` still place a footer `record:discussion`, and get no icon. `sys-user` and `sys-organization` have feeds off; `sys-approval-request` has no discussion block on purpose. How a hand-written page opts into the panel is a phase 2 card.
- **The 动态 tab keeps one chip on the desktop, 变更** (seat L2, 16:44Z): the card removes 全部 / 活动 / 讨论 only, and 变更 (objectstack#30074) is merged behaviour, offered on the same rule (only where the record shows its field history). With no 全部 beside it, the chip is a toggle: pressed again, it goes back to every entry. The phone keeps all its chips.
- **The 动态 count leaves the comments out** wherever the panel is offered (page payload total less the comments it counted).
- The panel draws every comment the read holds, oldest first, with no 20-row page: a conversation is read to its end.
- Not in this PR: the resolved UI, the filter menu and the unresolved count (wait #36071, wired in a second PR if #36071 is slow); until then this PR is `Part of #36075`. The shared avatar and the delete toast from #36070 are in: main was merged after #36105 landed at 16:04Z. Reactor names on hover are not on the card.

## Verification

**New tests (all pass)**

- `plugin-detail/src/comments/commentThreads.test.ts` (6): comment rows only, oldest first; replies and a reply to a reply nested; an orphan reply kept; same-instant order; a parent loop loses nothing; latest repliers.
- `plugin-detail/src/comments/CommentsPanel.test.tsx` (13): oldest first, system rows left out; collapse and expand; Reply focuses the reply box and answers the thread's first comment; Edit and Delete only on the viewer's own comment; More → Delete, More → Edit saves; React; read-only offers no actions and no box; add, and the draft kept on a refused write; ✕ and Esc; empty; refused and failed with Retry; the icon's count and pressed state.
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordActivity.commentsInPanel-36075.test.tsx` (7): no comments or composer in the stream and 变更 the one chip, with the control; the lone 变更 chip toggles back to every entry; no chip where the record shows no field history; a refused comment read does not replace the system entries; the count probe counts system entries only, with the control; an authored `record:activity` untouched.
- `app-shell/src/views/recordCommentsPanel.drawerEscape-36075.test.tsx` (8): the REAL `NavigationOverlay` around the REAL panel, at the stack's root (a record opened from the list) and below it. Esc in the comment box and on ✕ closes the panel, the drawer stays at its level, and the focus returns to the icon. Esc in the `@` list closes the list only. CONTROL: Esc on a record control outside the panel does what the drawer always did. With either fix removed, its pins fail (4 of 8 without the drawer change).
- `CommentsPanel.test.tsx` +2: Esc in the `@` list keeps the panel and the draft, and the next Esc closes the panel; Esc in the More menu closes the menu only. Both fail with their fix removed.
- `RecordDetailView.commentsPanel-36075.test.tsx` +1: Delete in the panel goes through the page's confirm and toasts 「Comment deleted」 (#36070).
- `app-shell/src/views/recordCommentsPanel-36075.test.ts` (2): the 1280 and 760 thresholds.
- `components/src/__tests__/record-top-bar-comments-36075.test.tsx` (2): the slot sits ahead of the button group in both bar shapes.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.commentsPanel-36075.test.tsx` (8), the real `RecordDetailView`: icon and count on the default page; open beside at 1440 and close; over at 1100; kept open for the next record; drawer cover, remembered apart from the page; the stream draws no comment and the panel does, once; no icon with feeds off; no icon on a hand-written page, which keeps its discussion.

**Changed tests**: 38 cases in 11 `RecordDetailView.*` files read the default page's comments off the 动态 stream; they now read them in the comment panel (same rows, same reads, same grants), and the counts drop the comments: `feedLoading`, `feedRecordScope`, `feedLoadFailure-29188`, `harness` (feedRefusal-11195), `replyCountOnRead-12144`, `discussionExplicitComposition-7298`, `discussionFallbackPipeline-8983`, `recordOpenOneRequest-28470`, `recordOpenWaves-13010`, `recordPageTiers-26678` (变更 alone, a toggle, where `trackHistory` is on and the audit read answers; no chip without it or on a 403), `timelineCount-28737`. Authored-page cases in those files are unchanged. No test deleted or skipped.

**Local runs**: every `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.*`, `recordDrawer*` and `components/src/custom` test file (98 files) pass, the 11 above after their change and three that first failed to resolve `@objectstack/client` before its build on a re-run; every new file above passes. The whole app-shell, plugin-detail and components suites (3,274 files) did not fit a local run and were stopped; CI is the full reading. `type-check` (src and tests) clean for plugin-detail, components and app-shell; ESLint on every changed file: 0 errors; `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:new-line-citations` pass; `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against main and the 6 open PRs that share a file.

**Browser evidence** (CRM example on `objectstack dev`, console on Vite, zh-CN, an account seeded with three threads, one with two replies): `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36075/` (seat-side folder).

| Reading | Result |
|---|---|
| Page, 1440, light and dark, panel closed → open | icon 「3」, pressed when open; panel `beside`, 380 wide at x 1060; the record columns narrow to leave it the width |
| Page, 1100, light and dark | panel `over`, 380 wide at the right edge, record columns keep their width |
| Drawer (list → Initech), light and dark | the icon in the drawer's record row; panel `cover`, the drawer body's whole width (718) |
| Thread states | 「2 条回复」 with the replier's face; expanded with the reply box and 「收起回复」; hover row (回复, 表情, 更多) with 编辑 / 删除 open |
| 动态 tab | no 全部 / 活动 / 讨论 chips, no composer, no comment rows (shot taken before the 变更 chip was kept) |
| A record with no comments | empty state with the hint, composer at the foot |
